paragraphs: This is how I try to work. I don't get it right every time.

pledges.title: Culture is king
pledges.text: I want people on the team who see things I miss. That only helps if they can tell me when I'm wrong. Making room for that is part of leading.

pledges.title: Framing is first
pledges.text: Before I estimate a job, I want to know what problem we're solving. I've seen good code go out on time and solve the wrong thing. A conversation at the start is cheaper than a rewrite.

pledges.title: Documentation and clear decisions
pledges.text: I write down why we made a decision. If the facts change, I want to be able to read it back and disagree with myself. It also gives the next engineer or agent somewhere to start.

pledges.title: Right-aligned development
pledges.text: Before I take a new ticket, I read the board from right to left. Is someone waiting for a review? Is someone stuck on a thing I know? Five minutes there can be worth more than another ticket in progress.

pledges.title: Honesty over polish
pledges.text: If the CV can't back up a claim, leave it out. That's the idea behind the job matcher here. It can tell you where the evidence runs out.

pledges.title: No absolutism in technological choices
pledges.text: I want code people can maintain and agents can follow. I'll break a rule when the product needs it. I write down why. This site uses Next.js. The first design suggested Astro, and the decision record explains the change.
